## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Shì tóngzǐ jīng* (T527) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by the Western Jìn translator Zhī Fǎdù 支法度 ([支法度](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E6%B3%95%E5%BA%A6)). The protagonist *Shì tóngzǐ* 逝童子 ("the Boy Shì") is parallel to [KR6i0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0158) *Púsà Shì jīng* (T528).

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna*-style narrative on a boy who attains bodhisattva-vyākaraṇa. Zhī Fǎdù was active around 290–306 CE in the late Western Jìn; this is one of his few surviving translations. Cf. [KR6i0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0158) for the parallel text by Bái Fǎzǔ.
